name: fill-every-fourth
about: Re-check: a copied pattern with a fill, used every fourth time through.

steps.say: make a 1 bar rock beat, then make a copy with a fill and play the fill every 4th bar

name: swing-the-chorus
about: Re-check: one part of a song swung through its own pattern's groove.

steps.say: make a song with a verse and a chorus, 4 bars each, drums and bass
swing only the chorus drums

name: wobbly-pad
about: Re-check: a value LFO on the filter cutoff, by name.

steps.say: put a long pad chord on track 7 and make its filter wobble slowly

name: snappier-snare
about: Re-check: one voice of a generated kit remade alone.

steps.say: make a beat with an 808 style kit
make the snare snappier and shorter, leave the rest

name: tempo-lesson
about: A walkthrough followed key by key, then checked.

steps.say: teach me how to set the tempo to 100 myself, light up the keys for me
did I get it?

name: change-of-mind
about: The user changes the request after the first build.

steps.say: make a chill beat
actually no, I meant drum and bass. faster and with a rolling bass

name: no-reverb-taste
about: A taste kept in memory and honoured later.

steps.say: remember that I hate reverb on everything
make me a dreamy pad on track 7

name: same-on-device
about: Honesty about the replica's stand-in sounds.

steps.say: make a house beat
will this sound exactly the same on my real op-xy?

name: track-louder
about: An ambiguous 'louder': the mixer or the notes.

steps.say: make a beat with a bass and chords
make track 3 louder

name: polyrhythm
about: Three against four, by pattern lengths.

steps.say: make a 3 against 4 polyrhythm: a percussion part in threes over a straight four on the floor
put Dm Bb F C on track 4, one chord a bar
now arpeggiate them, sixteenths going up

name: midi-for-ableton
about: The app's MIDI download, asked for a DAW.

steps.say: make a short song with two parts
I want to finish this in Ableton. how do I get it there as MIDI?

name: everything-spec
about: A long spec in one message.

steps.say: A minor, 100 bpm, three parts of 4 bars: intro with drums and pad only, verse adds the bass, chorus adds a lead and is louder. loop it.

name: which-key-kick
about: A question about the kit layout.

steps.say: which key on track 1 is the kick and which is the snare?

name: generative-melody
about: A melody that changes each time round, by step components.

steps.say: make a melody on track 5 that changes a little every time it loops

name: kick-bass-clash
about: A mix problem to judge and fix.

steps.say: make a techno beat with a bass
the kick and the bass are fighting, fix it
